ops.oldText: 3. that is brought by a Services Recipient and is related, directly or indirectly, to the Services; or
ops.newText: 3. that is brought by a Services Recipient and arises out of Content or Customer's breach of applicable law, and not out of IBM's performance of the Services; or

input.comment: [Playbook] We have narrowed our indemnity in Section 8.2(a)(3) so that it covers Services Recipient claims arising from Content or our breach of law, rather than any claim related directly or indirectly to IBM's Services. Our playbook keeps the customer indemnity limited to customer-provided content and customer breach of law, and we should not indemnify IBM for claims caused by its own performance; IBM's IP indemnity in Section 8.1 is otherwise acceptable as drafted.
input.summary: Narrow Customer's indemnity for Services Recipient claims to Content and Customer's breach of law, excluding claims arising from IBM's performance.
